Joke endings include the game line that answers them (game_lines). facebook_at is each reel's own Facebook slot (one a day, 04:00 UTC); the guide reels hold 04:00 UTC until 2026-12-04, so these start 2026-12-05 and are booked from the main session. shorts.hook: Each red icon is a clue
shorts.title: GTA 6 Tip: What the Red Icons Under Your Stars Mean
shorts.blurb: The red icons under your wanted stars are what the police know about you: outfit, face, car and weapon. Clear them one by one to lose the cops.
